demand_rank: z The QLFS and CareerJunction data were analysed. z A four-digit OFO-coded list was produced. z An online survey was distributed to allow employers to list occupations they will be recruiting for in the future. z The OIHD that were indicated by the survey sample were manually mapped to their appropriate six-digit OFO codes. z The secondary data from the QLFS and CareerJunction was combined with the survey data to calculate overall demand scores.
